descriptionChirho: The Hebrew proper name meaning 'Yahweh is salvation', referring primarily to the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz who ministered during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah of Judah (8th century BCE). All grammatical variants — nominative, with conjunction (and-Isaiah), and different discourse positions — refer to the same proper name. Multilingual renderings are uniform: eng 'Isaiah/Yeshayahu', spa 'Isaias/Yeshayahu', hin 'yashayahu' (यशायाहू), arb 'Isha'ya' (إِشَعْيَا/إِشَعْيَاءُ), kor 'Isaya' (이사야), swa 'Isaya/Yeshaya'. The 35 occurrences span 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, and Isaiah itself.
